description: This PHP class 'Promotion' is part of the Opencart installation controller, responsible for making a remote HTTP request to fetch promotional or installation-related data from the Opencart server.

classes.name: Promotion
classes.description: Controller class responsible for fetching remote promotion or installation data during setup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the OpenCart API endpoint to retrieve promotion or installation data and returns the response as a string.
